description: Fork of exp071 (1.7088 @ 8K, leak fix) widening v_lut: d_v 16->24, v_input_nap 7->8 (table_dim 128->256). E=96 unchanged. Side-effect: H*d_v becomes 144 (was 96), so out_proj input_dim grows. v_lut weights: 6*256*256*24=9.44M/layer (was 3.15M/layer). Total params ~167M (was 129.3M). Pair coverage: qk unchanged at 33.7%, v 39.3->44.9% per head, out_proj L2-5 drops from saturated 134.7% to 59.7% due to bigger input space.
